_comment: Template. Wake commands for the job-board dispatcher (job_dispatcher.py reads this file from the working tree). The commands use bare names that must be on your PATH: codex, claude, dsh. Edit job_agents for your machine (full paths, other flags) before the first job. {repo} and {prompt} are filled in by the dispatcher. task_branch: tasks are created only on this branch (set it to your default branch, e.g. main or master). commit_guard: "scoped" makes the commit-msg hook (install_hooks.py) check claims and append-only files; see README section 3, Commit guard. The gpt command passes --disable multi_agent so that a wake starts no Codex sub-agents (README section 9, Wake cost).

claude: Read,Edit,Write,Grep,Glob,Bash(python3 *),Bash(python *),Bash(source *),Bash(conda activate *),Bash(git status*),Bash(git log*),Bash(git diff*),Bash(git show*),Bash(ls *),Bash(cat *),Bash(head *),Bash(tail *),Bash(wc *),Bash(date*)
